name: Popify – Sales Popups & Social Proof
author: importify

sections.description:
Popify is the all-in-one tool for creating trust-driven sales and social proof popups that increase engagement and grow conversions.

🚀 How Popify Can Help Your Business Grow

Popify helps build trust by showing that people are actively engaging with your store – browsing, purchasing, and enjoying your products.
When visitors see real activity from other customers, they feel more confident in their own
purchase decisions.
Creating a sense of social proof and urgency encourages shoppers to act faster and complete
their purchases.

🌟 Why Choose Popify

  • Create real-time sales popups that display recent orders and build a sense of urgency.

  • Show customer review popups and positive feedback to encourage visitors to complete
    their purchases.

  • Build trust by displaying verified sales and genuine customer activity.

  • Create beautiful popups in less than 20 seconds using ready-to-use templates.

  • Fully optimized for mobile devices for a seamless experience.

  • Increase engagement and conversions with clickable notifications that lead directly to
    your products.

  • Easily translate and customize any text in your preferred language.

  • Adjust design, position, timing, and display settings to match your store’s style.

🔔What Kind of Popup Notifications Can I Create?

  1. Customer Activity Popups
    Show real-time notifications of recent purchases and add-to-cart events.

  2. Personalized Offers & Events Popups
    Communicate with your visitors through notifications for event reminders, personalized
    offers with call-to-action links, news, and updates.

  3. Review Popups
    Display recent product reviews from real customers. (Requires the Editorify or Ryviu app.)

  4. Discount Popups
    Highlight special offers, flash sales, or discount coupons to encourage faster decisions.

  5. Visitor Counter Popups
    Show how many visitors are currently browsing your store or have visited in the last 24
    hours.

  6. Product Purchase Counter
    Display the total number of recent orders for each product to strengthen social proof.

🌟How to Use Popify

Popify is easy to set up and simple to use.
After installation, you can create a new popup notification or choose from a variety of ready-to-use templates.

🛒Abandoned Cart Recovery

Yes, Popify supports abandoned cart recovery for Basic plan users and above.
Use push notifications on your WooCommerce store to remind visitors about unfinished
purchases and encourage them to complete checkout.
Popify can automatically send a sequence of three notifications to remind customers about
their abandoned carts.

🚀How Popify Helps You Grow

  • Build social proof and trust through real-time activity popups.
  • Increase visitor engagement with interactive notifications.
  • Create upsell opportunities using targeted popups.
  • Add clickable notifications that direct users to your products.
  • Recover abandoned carts with automated reminders.
  • Display review notifications to show customer satisfaction.
  • Customize popup styles (colors, text, position, timing, and pages).
  • Display mobile-friendly popups for better engagement on all devices.

❌Can I Cancel My Account Anytime?

Yes. You can cancel your recurring payment at any time if you decide Popify is not the right fit for your business.
sections.installation:
Popify plugin installation is as as easy as it gets, it works with both WordPress and WooCommerce on your websites.
Popify automatically connects to your WordPress website and Woocommerce store and pulls orders and add to carts as they happen.

Instructions:

  1. Install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen OR unzip the plugin archive to ‘/wp-content/plugins’
  2. In the WordPress ‘Plugins’ page, activate the plugin.
  3. Select “Popify” menu item from your admin sidebar.
  4. Click on “Go To Dashboard”
  5. From the Popify dashboard, click on “Create new Popup”
  6. Done. Sit back and watch how social proof boosts your sales!
sections.faq:
I have a small website, can I open an account for free?

Yes! You can start a free account which is for 100 website visitors per month. No credit card required.

How the site visitors are being counted?

A unique monthly visitor is anyone who visits one of your website pages with our code in the last 30 days. A visitor can generate several sessions and view more than 1 page, but they will still only be counted as a single visitor as long as they didn’t delete browser cookies, or used a different device or browser. You can always see your monthly usage on the credit usage section.

What kind of conversion rates can I expect?

Conversion rates on your website may double, triple or increase even more. The extent of positive effect depends on a number of factors, such as: attractiveness of offers you make on the popup notifications you display, how many popups you use, targeting, display timing, etc.

Will I need a web developer to handle code embedding?

No need, after installing the plugin you’re good to go!

Can I use my own designs?

Yes! You can create uniquely designed popups using our popups editor.

How do I reach out to Popify’s support team?
